narrative.overview:
A calm working environment where the evidence of study carries the visual weight. Apple minimalism supplies restraint, Linear supplies precision, Attio supplies record organization, and Things supplies straightforward lists. The interface uses one coherent sans-serif family, open alignment and a small number of distinct surface treatments.

Light mode is the primary identity. Off-white analytical surfaces sit on a soft-silver canvas, with a deeper silver sidebar and pure white reserved for elevated dialogs. Dark mode uses neutral charcoal rather than a navy wash. The existing labelled sidebar and Study tools disclosure remain the navigation grammar. The second approved pass removes the notebook grid and decorative subject-cover shelf.
keyCharacteristics: Open reading areas and compact, aligned records.
Deliberate numerical hierarchy with tabular data.
Quiet neutral controls with restrained slate-blue chart roles.
Short state transitions and full reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Role Consistency Rule
rules.body: Assign colour through shared reading, action, focus and analytical roles so controls remain legible across themes.

rules.name: The Evidence Scale Rule
rules.body: A result earns size through importance. Marks, time and counts use tabular numerals; labels explain each measure without competing with it.

rules.name: The Open Record Rule
rules.body: Use alignment and quiet separators to organize repeated work instead of turning every item into a bordered card.

rules.name: The Purposeful Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevate a reading surface or an interruption; keep ordinary records visually open.

dos: Do give saved evidence and useful actions a clear reading order.
Do keep labelled navigation, explicit focus states and readable supporting text.
Do vary open lists, analytical surfaces and intentional feature areas according to their purpose.
Do preserve existing data, routes and controls when extending this visual system.
donts: Don't restore the notebook grid or decorative cover shelf to this approved workspace.
Don't wash all surfaces in blue or rely on faint text for hierarchy.
Don't turn every record into an identical bordered card.
Don't invent scores, dates or chart data to fill empty states.
